Navigation

Localizer performance dengan panduan vertikal

An instrument approach procedure (APV) that provides both lateral and vertical guidance using satellite-based augmentation systems, similar to ILS precision but based on GPS/WAAS signals.

Quick answer: An instrument approach procedure (APV) that provides both lateral and vertical guidance using satellite-based augmentation systems, similar to ILS precision but based on GPS/WAAS signals.

Definition

An instrument approach procedure (APV) that provides both lateral and vertical guidance using satellite-based augmentation systems, similar to ILS precision but based on GPS/WAAS signals.

Operational example

Cleared for the Localizer Performance with Vertical Guidance approach to runway two-six, report established.

Localized term

Localizer performance dengan panduan vertikal

Localized example
